conversation.text:
Police: What Auntie said is all true, right? You must not lie.
Respondent: Auntie told me that sometimes people need kind lies rather than the truth.
Respondent: She said that lying itself isn’t bad—only bad lies are bad.
Respondent: Mom said she would watch over us from heaven. She told me that even if she passed away, she would protect us from the sky.
Respondent: But...
Respondent: She was lying. There is no such thing as heaven in this world.
Respondent: Xiyuan still doesn’t know that mom lied.
Respondent: She still foolishly believes what mom said...
Respondent: If mom is a liar,
Respondent: then is she also a bad person?
